The acquisition index is retained in ``source_well``; no laboratory microplate geometry is inferred. ``overwrite`` False by default — existing targets are left alone. ``db_path`` when set, :func:`populate_db_from_map` loads the map into it. ``preview_only`` print the plan and stop. records.source: ``src`` folder to convert. Required. ``dst`` destination; defaults to ``<src>_yokogawa``. Never ``src``. ``layout`` / ``z_handling`` / ``plate_naming`` passed to :func:`scan` and :func:`plan`. ``metadata_well_map`` local CSV path with ``plate,index,well`` columns. Indexed ScanR needs an explicit physical well for every observed plate/W index. The acquisition index is retained in ``source_well``; no plate geometry is inferred. ``overwrite`` False by default — existing targets are left alone. ``db_path`` when set, :func:`populate_db_from_map` loads the map into it. ``preview_only`` print the plan and stop. The returned result has written nothing and has no ``map_path``. ``resume`` accept complete fields from a compatible checkpoint after validating every output TIFF. ``checkpoint_path`` optional checkpoint JSON path; defaults inside ``dst``.
records.translation: ``src`` 要转换的文件夹。必填。``dst`` 目标路径；默认为 ``<src>_yokogawa``，绝不能为 ``src``。``layout`` / ``z_handling`` / ``plate_naming`` 传递给 :func:`scan` 和 :func:`plan`。``metadata_well_map`` 为本地 CSV 路径，列名为 ``plate,index,well``。带索引的 ScanR 要求为观测到的每个微孔板/W 索引组合明确指定实际物理孔位。采集索引保留在 ``source_well`` 中；不会推断微孔板几何布局。``overwrite`` 默认为 False，已有目标文件保持不变。设置 ``db_path`` 时，:func:`populate_db_from_map` 将映射加载到该数据库。``preview_only`` 输出计划后停止。返回的结果未写入任何内容，也没有 ``map_path``。``resume`` 在验证每个输出 TIFF 后，接受兼容检查点中已完成的显微视野。``checkpoint_path`` 为可选的检查点 JSON 路径；默认位于 ``dst`` 内。

records.context: explicit ``{well key: well id}`` or ``{(plate key, well key): well id}`` overrides. Indexed ScanR requires laboratory microplate-scoped overrides or a local CSV path with ``plate,index,well`` columns. Missing or conflicting assignments block conversion; its opaque W indices are never assigned synthetic physical microplate sample positions.
records.label: spacr.convert.plan#10
records.source: explicit ``{well key: well id}`` or ``{(plate key, well key): well id}`` overrides. Indexed ScanR requires plate-scoped overrides or a local CSV path with ``plate,index,well`` columns. Missing or conflicting assignments block conversion; its opaque W indices are never assigned synthetic physical wells.
records.translation: 显式的 ``{well key: well id}`` 或 ``{(plate key, well key): well id}`` 覆盖映射。带索引的 ScanR 要求提供限定到各微孔板的覆盖映射，或列名为 ``plate,index,well`` 的本地 CSV 路径。分配缺失或冲突会阻止转换；绝不会为其不透明的 W 索引人为编造物理孔位。

records.context: a filename convention from Mask's ``metadata_type`` list (``'opera_phenix'``, ``'cq1'``, ``'zeiss_zen_split_tiles'``, ...). When given, laboratory microplate, microplate sample position, microscope field of view, image data channel, z and t are read from each name by that convention's pattern, and the folders only supply what the name does not carry -- the laboratory microplate for a convention with no laboratory microplate group, the microplate sample position for one whose "well" is a scene index or a literal word. A file whose name does not follow the convention is reported unreadable, with the reason, rather than guessed at. ``None``, ``''`` and ``'auto'`` keep the folder-and-token inference, except indexed ScanR names beginning ``--W`` retain their opaque W token and require an explicit laboratory microplate-scoped microplate sample position map at planning time.
records.label: spacr.convert.scan#8
records.source: a filename convention from Mask's ``metadata_type`` list (``'opera_phenix'``, ``'cq1'``, ``'zeiss_zen_split_tiles'``, ...). When given, plate, well, field, channel, z and t are READ FROM EACH NAME by that convention's pattern, and the folders only supply what the name does not carry -- the plate for a convention with no plate group, the well for one whose "well" is a scene index or a literal word. A file whose name does not follow the convention is reported unreadable, with the reason, rather than guessed at. ``None``, ``''`` and ``'auto'`` keep the folder-and-token inference, except indexed ScanR names beginning ``--W`` retain their opaque W token and require an explicit plate-scoped well map at planning time.
records.translation: Mask 的 ``metadata_type`` 列表中的文件命名约定（``'opera_phenix'``、``'cq1'``、``'zeiss_zen_split_tiles'`` 等）。指定后，按照该约定的模式从每个名称中读取微孔板、孔位、显微视野、图像通道、z 和 t；文件夹只补充名称中没有的信息：约定没有微孔板分组时补充微孔板，当其 "well" 是场景索引或字面单词时补充孔位。名称不符合约定的文件会被报告为不可读并说明原因，而不会猜测。``None``、``''`` 和 ``'auto'`` 保留基于文件夹和名称标记的推断行为，但以 ``--W`` 开头的带索引 ScanR 名称会保留其不透明的 W 标记，并要求在规划阶段提供明确限定到各微孔板的孔位映射。

records.context: Search covers the processing-session id, module, status, setting names and values, input and output paths, warnings, failure traceback, and environment versions. Corrupt processing-session folders remain visible with ``"corrupt"`` status and diagnostic warnings. A stored ``"running"`` record is displayed as ``"interrupted"`` only when its recorded owner is provably gone; this does not change the stored status. Unverifiable owners, including records from other hosts, remain ``"running"``.
records.label: spacr.run_journal.search_runs#1
records.source: Search covers the run id, module, status, settings keys and values, input and output paths, warnings, failure traceback, and environment versions. Corrupt run folders remain visible with ``"corrupt"`` status and diagnostic warnings. A stored ``"running"`` record is displayed as ``"interrupted"`` only when its recorded owner is provably gone; this does not change the stored status. Unverifiable owners, including records from other hosts, remain ``"running"``.
records.translation: 搜索范围包括运行标识、模块、状态、设置键及其值、输入和输出路径、警告、失败回溯及环境版本。损坏的运行文件夹仍会显示，状态为 ``"corrupt"``，并附有诊断警告。只有在能够证实记录的所有者进程已不存在时，存储为 ``"running"`` 的记录才会显示为 ``"interrupted"``；这不会更改存储的状态。无法验证的所有者（包括其他主机的记录）仍显示为 ``"running"``。
